name: device
title: Device
description: Photographic PNG frames for iPhone, iPad, MacBook, and Android.

files.content:
Device frame image sources

The Device component and its measured frame coordinates are distributed
under the Supervisor MIT license. Image licenses are listed separately below.

MacBook Pro 14 inch

public/devices/macbook-pro-14-space-black.png is a retouched adaptation of
AzureSaturn's photograph of a 14 inch M5 MacBook Pro in Space Black.
The source photograph was published under CC0. Supervisor releases this
adaptation under CC0 as well, to the extent it holds rights in the image.

Source photograph:
https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:MacBook_Pro_(14-inch,_M5,_Space_Black).jpg
License:
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

Changes: reconstructed a centered front view with an image editing tool,
removed the surroundings and screen content, and added an alpha channel.
This is a retouched illustration based on a photograph, not an unaltered
product photograph or an official Apple asset.

Editing brief: preserve the slim bezel, camera notch, dark aluminum body,
and metallic edges; use a straight front view with a narrow base; remove
all surrounding objects and screen content; create a transparent PNG frame.

The PNG is served from:
https://ui.trysupervisor.com/devices/macbook-pro-14-space-black.png

Mobile FIRST presets

The iPhone, iPad, and Android PNG images are hosted by Mobile FIRST and
are not included in this package or covered by the Supervisor MIT license.
Mobile FIRST permits personal and commercial use, modification, and cropping
of these mockups. Its model pages prohibit resale or redistribution of the
frame file alone. Refer to the source pages for the image terms before
downloading, hosting, or otherwise using the files.

iPhone 17
https://www.webmobilefirst.com/en/mockups/apple-iphone-17-2025/

iPad Pro, source listing 2018
https://www.webmobilefirst.com/en/mockups/apple-ipad-pro-11-2018/

Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra, source listing 2026
https://www.webmobilefirst.com/en/mockups/samsung-galaxy-s26-ultra-2026/

https://www.webmobilefirst.com/en/license-agreement/

The component requests original image URLs directly without a proxy or
image optimization. Their availability depends on the host. Set frameSrc
to a local path to use your own authorized copy of a preset PNG, or supply
a custom frame with its own image and screen coordinates.

Source pages checked September 11, 2026.
